# オークハウス (Oakhouse)

> > Japan's leading provider of sharehouses, furnished apartments, and social residences across Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, and other major cities, specializing in international exchange living and flexible short-term rentals.

Oakhouse operates shared living spaces and furnished apartments throughout Japan, offering no-deposit, flexible monthly contracts with a focus on international community building. The platform serves major metropolitan areas including Tokyo (Shibuya, Meguro, Kamata, Kichijoji), Saitama, Chiba, Kyoto, Osaka, Hyogo, and Fukuoka prefectures.

## Key Topics

- シェアハウス (Sharehouse)
- ソーシャルレジデンス (Social Residence)
- 家具家電付きアパート (Furnished Apartments)
- 国際交流 (International Exchange)
- 短期賃貸 (Short-term Rental)
- 東京都 (Tokyo)
- 大阪府 (Osaka)
- 京都府 (Kyoto)
- 敷金礼金なし (No Deposit/Key Money)
- 月額契約 (Monthly Contract)
- 外国人入居可 (Foreigner-friendly)
- グランステイ (Granstay Premium)
- オークアパートメント (Oak Apartment)
- 家具付き物件 (Furnished Properties)
